title: Fix review-found safety regressions
summary: Fix review-found queue override validation, worktree change-packet coverage, release metadata, release packaging exclusions, and operator path documentation.
reason: The review found a series exact-selector safety gap, overly broad strict worktree coverage, stale dirty build metadata, an unsafe local root-artifact capture, and wrong release script paths.
behavior_before: Series file overrides could batch-save exact audio/subtitle selectors without validating every eligible row, strict worktree coverage could accept unrelated dirty files through broad directory entries, package metadata carried a stale dirty suffix, and release docs referenced nonexistent script paths.
behavior_after: Series exact selectors are validated for every eligible row before preview/apply can succeed, strict worktree coverage requires exact file entries, committed package metadata no longer carries a dirty suffix, release policy excludes local root artifacts, and release docs point at canonical scripts.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_file_override_tracks tests.python.tooling.test_change_control -v - passed (53 tests)
Test-Path docs/archive/root-artifacts/CON.txt and src/mediapipeline.egg-info - both absent
git diff --check on touched files and generated summaries - passed
rg stale release paths / stale dirty version metadata - no matches
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed only for unrelated uncovered dirty files outside this packet
rollback_plan: Revert the series exact-selector validation callback, packet coverage exact-worktree mode, metadata normalization, release-policy root-artifact exclusion, changelog path edits, and focused regression tests.
notes: High risk because Queue file overrides can affect subtitle/audio selection, but this change blocks unsafe exact-selector batches and does not alter FFmpeg command generation or runtime audio/subtitle policy.
